# Avatar · image · mask · idol

## #0

Presence becomes addressable through a form. This authored Mytheme follows how that form makes encounter possible and how its success can turn into possession. A face turns towards someone; a name lets that person be called again; a gesture carries an intention into a shared situation. A role gives an undertaking a recognisable place. Someone can now be met, remembered, trusted, opposed or answered. The form's finitude lets this encounter occur here, between these participants.

The whole begins with this gift of mediation. A person does not first become complete in isolation and subsequently add a public mask. Language, bodily expression, histories of recognition and shared practices participate in the life that appears. Yet no achieved presentation finishes that life. The person who was named can answer differently; the person remembered can have changed; the one approached through a role can question what the role permits. Maintained personhood is this consequential continuity through different appearances, including the capacity to alter how one is received.

Taylor's [avatar–image–mask–idol programme] develops one authored ecology through four distinguishable offices. Avatar concerns presence becoming effective in a finite appearance. Image concerns the particular formation that gathers attention and value. Mask concerns the presentation through which participation becomes possible. Idol concerns the closure by which a successful formation takes possession of the authority it was meant to mediate. These offices can meet in one form; their relation is not a historical claim that four traditions tell one story.

The native ground is the complete relation articulated in [Taylor's core](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md): parent `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, and return `1/0`. The form is a determination within that movement, not its self-sufficient origin. Question can address assertion; an instance can expose the capacity through which it was formed; the personed encounter can change the account; the achieved account can return as a condition of another determination. The six passages of this whole follow that possibility through appearance, efficacy, participation, capture and renewed address. They do not assign an extra native position to each of its four names.

## #1

The avatar brings a wider presence into a particular encounter. In this authored use, descent names the movement into a form that can act: a voice rather than every possible voice, a gesture rather than intention without expression, an entrusted representative rather than an undertaking with no bearer. The presence is not made unreal by having an appearance. It acquires an occasion on which it can matter.

That occasion preserves a difference of office. A representative can speak authoritatively within a commission; the representative's statement remains answerable to what was entrusted. Even the original instruction is already a formulation. It cannot exhaust the intention simply because it was written first. [Authored Ground and Positional Delegation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **grounds** this recursive relation: the human, institution or agent occupying a source-position is situated in a wider field, and the prompt is already a determination. Authority can be exact and effective without becoming absolute sourcehood.

The avatar's body belongs to the encounter it enters. A voice needs someone who can hear it; a gesture acquires consequences in a shared situation; an entrusted representative inherits a commission and answers through what the representation does. The source relation passes into action, where another participant can accept, question or refuse it. That response becomes part of the form's history. Taylor's avatar names this effective finite presence; the particular Sanskrit and theological histories retain their separate source tasks.

An image makes that presence available under a particular arrangement. The arrangement can be faithful without being exhaustive. A remembered face, an emblem or a written account selects; selection gives recognition its precision. The source/reflection distinction also has direction. A reflection can be encountered first in time while remaining dependent on what it reflects. Within a declared Context Frame, an achieved image or source record can genuinely occupy **Bimba**, the local original against which further readings are compared. The same field occupies **pratibimba**, situated reflection, relative to its wider sources. [Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **grounds** this recursive office: the local original gives agreement and error a definite reference, and what those comparisons return can revise that original itself. Its authority is real at the scale of the inquiry. Idolisation begins when it prevents its own source relation from being questioned or changed.

## #2

The image gathers force. Attention returns to it; desire and fear organise themselves around it; expectations begin to make some possibilities vivid and others difficult to receive. A picture that once expressed a situation can become a measure for the next situation. The person making or interpreting it is changed through that activity. The formation acquires a history, and its later efficacy includes what its earlier appearances have done.

[Symbolon Dynamics](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **sources** this native reciprocal movement. Archetypal capacity, particular image and organising complex have different offices. An archetype is not one finished portrait; an image is not the whole capacity from which further images can arise; a complex organises a field of response around a consequential formation. Attention, libido, desire and valuation name different aspects or registers of that efficacy. Their relation here does not turn them into interchangeable physical energies.

The shared [Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md) **grounds** the archetypal structuration through which this image ecology takes form. The round holds the parental relation before its differentiated figures appear. Nourishing and engulfing faces of origin give dependence its contrary possibilities; separation of the world parents opens a world in which powers can be distinguished. The hero gains an effective position within that world, then encounters the limits of identifying life with the victorious image. Transformation returns the achieved differentiation into relation with what it had subordinated or excluded. Each formation carries a capacity that its own established image can subsequently confine.

Taylor's encounter with [Neumann's source](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness.md) **sources** the extension through the whole native field: relation, conscious circumstance, question and assertion, withdrawal and extension, determining capacity and instance, personed context, differential horizon and return. The complementary folds remain active within this movement: question answers in a personed world, felt force acquires a readable pattern, and the conscious circumstance retains its inexhaustible depth. This universal structuration is Taylor's argued appointment. Neumann's ego-development sequence supplies a distinct psychological account; it neither limits the native field to ego chronology nor assigns each culture a position on that sequence.

The image's efficacy reaches the body as well as its account. In Taylor's *Symbolon Dynamics*, libido concerns psychic investment and valuation; prāṇa concerns living circulation through breath, rhythm and differentiated current; Śakti concerns manifestation-power, including the concealment of source within its formation and its return through recognition. A repeated image can gather desire, alter the rhythm of attention and make a once-unavailable response possible. These registers disclose different operations of that efficacy. Their coordination belongs to Taylor's synthesis; their names do not license a common physical measurement or transfer one tradition's evidence into another.

An image's success therefore creates the pressure that will test it. A form that has held a life together has a claim upon attention. Revising it can threaten a valued coherence, an institution's continuity or a familiar account of oneself. The test concerns what this coherence can receive. If a new encounter changes the meaning, valuation or jurisdiction of the image, symbolic efficacy remains alive. If every encounter must confirm it, the interpreter's apparent fidelity begins to protect the image from the relation that made it significant.

The whole **returns-to** [Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) through this change in authority. An image mediates while its source relation remains active; idolisation appropriates that relation. A vivid or beloved image is not thereby an idol. Nor does a quiet, abstract or apparently rational account escape the test. The decisive change is in authority: whether the encountered source can still alter what the image is allowed to mean and do.

## #3

The image becomes a mask when it offers a way to enter a social field. Language, manner, clothing, credentials and the expectations of a role make someone legible to others. A mask can protect an intimacy, sustain a public obligation or let a person exercise capacities that would otherwise have no recognised place. Learning to wear it is an achievement of participation. There is no demand here for a person to become completely exposed in order to be real.

The pressure appears when access depends upon the presentation so completely that its bearer must administer life according to the recognising field's measure. What began as an interface becomes an internal criterion. The person anticipates what will count, edits what can be shown and may come to receive an unapproved response as a defect in the self. The mask continues to open doors while narrowing the life that can pass through them. This is the programme's argued operation of self-administration, not a clinical diagnosis or an empirical claim about every use of a social role.

The mask/chameleon seam retains a specific pressure: adaptation can grant access while requiring a bearer to reproduce the measure that renders parts of that bearer illegible. The surrounding field acts through the person's acquired skill in navigating it. The whole's present operation is this passage from participation into self-administration. The quilt holds its Fanonian and biographical development for a separate source-bearing recovery; those racial and colonial histories remain distinct from this general authored relation.

The distinction is sharply staged in [*The Prisoner*](../../../../episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner.md). After resignation, an unnamed intelligence agent is abducted into the Village and designated Number Six. Changing occupants hold the office of Number Two; the identity of Number One remains the question. When Six asks who One is, the answer assigns Six his place. Numbering gives the administrative office continuity across its occupants and gives the captive an identity the institution can administer. The question about power's source has been diverted into power's classification of the questioner.

The series' concluding *Fall Out* returns this question through masks and Six's own face, then through escape and an unresolved London return. That inward turn does not cancel the Village's coercive apparatus or declare captivity imaginary. The source house's finale account remains a written-witness recovery, distinct from a fully collated audiovisual sequence. In Taylor's refraction the return reaches both the institution and the claimant to sovereignty within the person. Replacing an administrator or removing a mask does not alone make the governing relation answerable. The programme's Two and Six also retain their dramatic office; they supply no proof of the native `4+2` generation.

## #4

The idol closes the path through the image. The bearer remains visible, perhaps more widely represented than before, while losing the ability to change the terms under which the representation acts. The category is permitted to know the person before encounter. Contrary speech is then classified as further evidence of the category. The image need not become inaccurate in every detail. Its protected jurisdiction lets even an accurate local description govern what exceeds that description.

Ovid's [Apollo and Daphne sequence](../../../../episteme/sources/classical-philology/ovid/ovid-1921-metamorphoses-miller/ovid-1921-metamorphoses-miller.md) gives this continued efficacy an exact body. Apollo's boast after Python leads to Cupid's opposed arrows. Daphne's prior refusal of marriage and Peneus's grant of that wish precede the pursuit. Apollo's powers do not make his desire hers. Exhaustion, appeal and transformation end with the laurel: the changed body is still felt as living, recoils from the kiss, and is claimed for Apollo's emblems. The ending also gives the tree an appearance of assent. Both details must remain; neither authorises replacing the whole encounter with uncomplicated consent. The authored image–idol reading concerns the emblem's power to continue after possession of the living other has failed. Roman literary telling, its Greek figures and its later interpretation retain different places and times.

The [biblical Job witness](../../../../episteme/sources/biblical-studies/anonymous/biblical-job-kjv-ebible-eng-kjv2006/biblical-job-kjv-ebible-eng-kjv2006.md) tests a different image: an account of divine justice. The councils, successive losses, bodily affliction and wife's challenge precede the friends' explanations. Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar first mourn and sit silently with Job; their later advocacy must be read against that initial accompaniment. Job's protest and defence of integrity resist an explanation which would require him to become the guilty person it needs. Wisdom in chapter 28 exceeds extraction and purchase; Elihu's separate intervention precedes the whirlwind. The divine speeches bring a world and creatures beyond Job's administration without explaining the councils to him. His response is followed by the friends' rebuke and their need for his intercession. Renewed household and social life do not erase the first children's deaths.

Taylor's protected-account reading follows this change in who can be heard and who must receive another's mediation. Jung's [*Answer to Job* comparison, §§614–617](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11.md#jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q002) has a separate office: he reads the treatment of the faithful witness as a crisis of the God-image requiring self-reflection and remembrance of Sophia. That is an attributed psychological interpretation. Sophia is not introduced as an actor in biblical Job 28, and Jung's reconstruction does not become Taylor's native derivation. The three registers meet through a stated relation without losing their tellings.

<a id="avatar-counterfeit-provenance"></a>
The subordinate **deepfake as counterfeit Symbolon** carries the closure into the claimed seam itself. In the [exact quilt passage](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), the apparent relation joins body to utterance, event to recording, speaker to voice, source to sign. A fabricated recording presented as a witness claims that this person spoke or this event occurred in the represented way. The counterfeit is more than a false proposition: it forges the apparent provenance by which the proposition asks to be trusted. A disclosed fictional construction has a different source claim and must be judged under that claim.

The next turn reaches the genuine record. Once fabrication is available as an explanation, a real witness can be dismissed as another synthetic appearance. The apparent source relation is attacked first by counterfeiting it and then by making the possibility of counterfeiting a reason to refuse its genuine instance. This is the locally argued second-order mechanism, often named the liar's dividend in the developmental passage; no prevalence, magnitude or documented media case is established here. Those empirical claims require independent evidence.

The counterfeit unit **returns-to** [Primordial Symbolon](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) through the distinction between a false statement and a fabricated slash, and to A20 through the image's appropriation of apparent source authority. It **returns-to** [The Mirror That Moves First](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) through the consequence for the next encounter: circulation can change what will be admitted as evidence. That argument's constructive third motion requires the instrument to expose its own source conditions before imposing its image upon the person addressed. The deepfake unit carries this contemporary operation within the four-office ecology.

## #5→0

Regard returns through the form to the participant who can answer it. The answer need not confirm the first question. It can disclose an omitted circumstance, refuse an imposed role, correct an attributed statement or show that the criterion itself has misnamed the encounter. The result is another determination with a changed history. Maintained personhood does not require an essence displayed without mediation; it requires that continuity of address not become ownership of the person addressed.

The [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this movement at operational register 3. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy retains what a presentation cannot finish; Criterion-through-Distinction makes its measure available; Delineation-through-Difference locates its frame. Arbitration-in-Crisis brings a consequential decision. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity lets the other and the framing conditions become visible through that decision. Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns the settlement with its history. Regard and anamnesis flower from these relations; they do not replace them or assert a common lexical ancestry.

The whole **returns-to** the [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) through all four of its operations. Symbol answers to source: identify what this form actually claims to bear. Account does not replace source: make the claim inspectable without transferring the person's standing to the report. Trust keeps the return route active: reliance must permit correction, refusal and consequences to reach the governing office. Account re-enters source-field: what an image has done belongs to the conditions of its next use. Provenance, signatures, audits or credentials can strengthen a specified evidential relation; their existence alone does not perform the undertaking of persons and institutions who must answer for its use.

An entrusted avatar can therefore remain powerful. Its source office is inspectable and revisable; the whole **returns-to** A28 through the actual authority of a situated delegation. A mask can continue to enable participation while allowing its bearer to exceed and alter its terms. An image can remain beloved while acquiring another meaning, or survive as an acknowledged historical sign after its former symbolic life has ended. Neither fidelity nor return obliges the bearer to continue an injurious encounter. Withdrawal can itself be the answer the representation must learn to receive.

The person, the image and the shared field return changed and still distinct. [Self and Other](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **grounds** their unity without possession; [Objective Co-Internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the way one encounter enters several participants' later conditions. The Neumann relation returns here through differentiated participation, without making ego chronology the limit of the native operation. The image has carried a presence into life. Its continuing integrity lies in allowing that life to answer back.

### Source relations and limits

**Human-amplified: yes** for the quilt's four-office ecology, its Daphne, Job and Number Six appointments, the category-before-encounter relation and the subordinate counterfeit-provenance operation. **Human-amplified: no** for new Fanonian/biographical amplification or identification of ancient divine descent with a software persona. This whole **returns-to** its argument consumers as Mytheme: the tellings make the relations lived and legible; their source-specific histories retain their own warrant.

The [Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](../../roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md) **figures** emblematic possession after withdrawal; the [Job whole](../../biblical/job/WHOLE.md) **figures** the witness and intercessor whom the protected account must finally hear; [The Prisoner whole](../../british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md) **figures** numbering, institutional continuity and the unresolved return through the sovereign mask. Those homes retain each telling's fuller movement and aftermath. Their conjunction here develops mediation's capacity to capture what it makes present.

Geography and time follow different relations here. Taylor's 2026 authorial world gathers the comparisons. Ovid's Roman literary work carries Greek figures; Job's narrated land of Uz, the biblical book and its later English witness have separate identities; the Village and London are dramatic places in a 1967–68 British television work. Neumann's twentieth-century psychological reception supplies shared structuration rather than a geographical origin for these works. The order of this page's six passages follows the image's operation, without proposing a historical transmission among its examples.

The [Parātrīśikā-Vivaraṇa house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md) **compares** Word, communication and subjectivity through Singh's introduction and translation, distinguished from Abhinavagupta's commentary. Its notebook passages remain source-matched. Exact avatāra doctrines and icon–idol histories remain source-choice and passage debts. [Aion](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md) **qualifies** the psychological comparison through its Self and symbolic-totality office; its selected house supplies no verified persona passage. Neumann's protected encounter carries Taylor's reading, with selected-copy quotations still unpromoted. The CW11 passage cited above supports the distinct Jungian God-image interpretation as paraphrase. These limits concern attribution and quotation; this whole retains **Argued** standing.
